en.title: SR 420.2 (SAFIG), Art. 9 para. 1: the German and Italian versions refer to Art. 10, the French version to a paragraph 10 that does not exist
en.summary: Art. 9 para. 1 of the Innosuisse Act (SAFIG) names the tasks under Art. 10 in the German and Italian versions and the tasks under «al. 10», a tenth paragraph of Art. 9, in the French version. Art. 9 has eight paragraphs; Art. 10 sets the tasks of the Innovation Council. The divergence is already in the original text in the Official Compilation (AS 2016 4259, p. 5).
en.impact: Readers of different language versions are sent to different provisions; at most one of them can be the one intended. No effect on a decision has been established.
en.correction: The authors of the act decide which reference is intended; the evidence gives the wording of each language version.

de.title: SR 420.2 (SAFIG), Art. 9 Abs. 1: deutsch und italienisch Verweis auf Art. 10, französisch auf einen Abs. 10, den es nicht gibt
de.summary: Die deutsche und die italienische Fassung von Art. 9 Abs. 1 SAFIG nennen die Aufgaben nach Art. 10, die französische die Aufgaben nach «al. 10», also nach einem zehnten Absatz von Art. 9. Art. 9 hat acht Absätze; Art. 10 regelt die Aufgaben des Innovationsrats. Die Abweichung steht bereits im ursprünglichen Text in der AS (AS 2016 4259, S. 5).

fr.title: RS 420.2 (LASEI), art. 9, al. 1 : les versions allemande et italienne renvoient à l'art. 10, la version française à un al. 10 qui n'existe pas
fr.summary: L'art. 9, al. 1, de la loi sur Innosuisse vise les tâches de l'art. 10 dans les versions allemande et italienne et les tâches de «l'al. 10», soit un dixième alinéa de l'art. 9, dans la version française. L'art. 9 compte huit alinéas ; l'art. 10 fixe les tâches du conseil de l'innovation. La divergence figure déjà dans le texte original publié au RO (RO 2016 4259, p. 5).

it.title: RS 420.2 (LASEI), art. 9 cpv. 1: le versioni tedesca e italiana rinviano all'art. 10, la versione francese a un al. 10 che non esiste
it.summary: L'art. 9 cpv. 1 della legge su Innosuisse indica i compiti di cui all'art. 10 nelle versioni tedesca e italiana e i compiti di cui all'«al. 10», cioè a un decimo capoverso dell'art. 9, nella versione francese. L'art. 9 ha otto capoversi; l'art. 10 stabilisce i compiti del Consiglio dell'innovazione. La divergenza figura già nel testo originale pubblicato nella RU (RU 2016 4259, p. 5).
